Issue #342 native negative-INFO fixtures (C-derived, not Rust-generated)

Files: {real,complex}.{ne0,ne1}.stdout, byte-for-byte output of the optional probe
c_toolbox/issue342_negative_info/probe.c. Consumed only by
crates/mvmc-core/tests/native342_negative_info.rs. Cargo never builds or reads
c_toolbox.

scope=NATIVE_KERNEL_STANDALONE (original C initializer + original kernels + real
pfapack Fortran + OpenBLAS XERBLA). Not a full vmc.out trajectory and not MPI
multi-rank (#179). The full vmc.out observation for the same Ne=0 input is
recorded in docs/reference/c-to-julia/verification/issue-342-negative-info.md
(not a fixture).

Platform: Linux x86_64 Dev Container image (vsc-mvmc-rs-...-uid)
compiler: gcc 13.3.0-6ubuntu2~24.04.1 via /opt/mpich/bin/mpicc, gfortran 13.3.0
BLAS: libopenblas0 0.3.26+ds-1ubuntu0.1 (XERBLA prints to stdout and RETURNS),
  OMP_NUM_THREADS=1, OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1
MPI: MPICH (/opt/mpich), probe uses MPI_COMM_SELF
compile: mpicc -O2 -fopenmp -DBLAS_EXTERNAL -DMEXP=19937 -D_lapack -D_mVMC -D_mpi_use
  (see c_toolbox/issue342_negative_info/run_probe.sh), linked with the
  CMake-built libpfapack.a, libltl2inv.a, libblis.a of extern/mVMC-1.3.0.

Only passive observation was added: the shared loop's CalculateMAll_fcmp call is
wrapped to log its INFO. Globals set directly with readdef.c:757-758 formulas;
LapackLWork from the original getLWork_fcmp (vmcmake/vmcmain.c:259). MakeProjCnt is
the original projection.c with NProj=0.

Cases (Nsite=2, one QP, seed 1, itinerant electrons only):
 ne0  Ne=0: Nsize=LDA=0 => ZSKTRF/DSKTRF INFO=-5 (argument 5), XERBLA returns,
      makeInitialSample exits after one attempt (flag<=0), returns 0, draws no RNG
      word, eleIdx empty, eleCfg all -1, eleNum all 0; PfM untouched (sentinel
      12345). The separate caller setup (vmcmake.c:110 / vmcmake_real.c:102) also
      returns -5 and is ignored.
 ne1  Ne=1 control: INFO 0, two placement words consumed.
